definitions.explanation: A person of great courage and bravery. In modern usage, strongly associated with the 'hero' character class in Japanese RPGs, anime, and fantasy stories — the chosen protagonist who fights evil.

examples.japanese: {勇者|ゆうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魔王|まおう}→魔王：14768_maou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}した→倒す：01954_taosu⟧。
examples.english: The hero defeated the demon king.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救|すく}った→救う：02063_sukuu⟧{勇者|ゆうしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{称|たた}えられた→称える：13751_tataeru⟧。
examples.english: He was praised as the hero who saved the village.

examples.english: In this game, the hero goes on an adventure around the world with companions.

notes:
In modern Japanese, {勇者|ゆうしゃ} is overwhelmingly associated with the hero archetype from RPGs and fantasy fiction — especially the Dragon Quest series, which established the "chosen hero who defeats the demon king" trope. The word has a more elevated, literary feel than ⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧ (hero in a historical or real-world sense).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勇者|ゆうしゃ} (legendary hero)
- {勇者|ゆうしゃ}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧ (hero's party)
- {勇者|ゆうしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{魔王|まおう}→魔王：14768_maou⟧ (hero and demon king)
